flags.why: This sense describes moonlight, so applying it to lamplight teaches an incorrect use ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Su%C3%B4ng)).
flags.fix: Đêm nay trăng suông, cảnh vật trông lạnh lẽo. = Tonight the moonlight is pale and hazy, making the surroundings look cold and bleak.

flags.why: Thân nhân is a formal term for relatives, especially in institutional contexts, rather than an ordinary casual family word.
The entry omits the common meaning of being overshadowed or becoming less prominent.
flags.fix: to be overshadowed; to become less prominent

flags.why: The supposed archaic meaning confuses chế biến with chế or ứng biến; chế biến means processing or transforming something ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Ch%E1%BA%BF_bi%E1%BA%BFn)).
Nhật báo belongs to formal publishing and journalistic usage and is misleading as an unmarked casual word.
